description: Open/closed status of a temple. The instant is converted to Vietnam time (UTC+7); the lunar day of that Vietnam date decides whether the Rằm & Mùng Một hours apply (lunar day 1 or 15, when the temple has them). Open when opening <= now < closing. Closed before opening → reopens at today's opening; after closing → reopens at the next day's opening (lunar rule applied to that day). vietnam_lunar_day_today (day/month) is given to check the lunar conversion and is not an extra input.

inputs.hours: {open, close} HH:mm Vietnam time, or null
inputs.holiday_hours: {open, close} for Rằm & Mùng Một, or null
inputs.vietnam_lunar_day_today: informative: lunar day/month of the Vietnam date

output.label: Vietnamese status line; empty when hidden
output.today_row: normal | holiday | null — the hours row marked 'Hôm nay'
